title: Learning Probabilistic Logic Programs with Functional Gradient Guided Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.12303v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Declarative logic programs offer a powerful and interpretable abstraction for encoding relational structure and neurosymbolic reasoning, by expressing dependencies as weighted compositional rules. However, inducing them from data remains fundamentally hard, bottlenecked by the combinatorial explosion of symbolic search spaces. LLMs have recently emerged as powerful hypothesis generators, but when used in isolation, they lack the capacity to do systematic inductive reasoning needed to reliably synthesize valid programs that fit complex relational distributions. We introduce grasp (Gradient-boosted Synthesis of Probabilistic logic programs), a neurosymbolic framework that casts relational structure learning as functional gradient boosting in which the weak learner is a first-order rule and the intractable inner search is delegated to an LLM proposal oracle. We evaluate grasp on four relational benchmarks spanning molecular toxicity predict

translated_title: 基于函数梯度引导语言模型的概率逻辑程序学习
translated_abstract: 声明式逻辑程序通过将依赖关系表示为加权的组合规则，为编码关系结构和神经符号推理提供了一种强大且可解释的抽象方法。然而，从数据中归纳逻辑程序从根本上仍然十分困难，其瓶颈在于符号搜索空间的组合爆炸。近年来，大型语言模型（LLMs）已成为强大的假设生成器，但如果孤立使用，它们缺乏进行系统性归纳推理的能力，难以可靠地合成符合复杂关系分布的有效程序。我们提出了grasp（Gradient-boosted Synthesis of Probabilistic logic programs，概率逻辑程序的梯度提升合成），这是一个神经符号框架，它将关系结构学习转化为函数梯度提升问题，其中弱学习器是一阶规则，而难以处理的内部符号搜索则委托给LLM提议预言机。我们在涵盖分子毒性预测等任务的四个关系基准上对grasp进行了评估（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出神经符号框架grasp，将关系结构学习建模为函数梯度提升问题，以一阶规则作为弱学习器，并把难以处理的符号搜索委托给LLM提议预言机，从而高效地学习概率逻辑程序。
